Tactics: Discovery
Platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS
Description: Inspecting a host's process list can reveal which programs are running. In this demo, use the process inventory to compare activity with an approved maintenance window.

Tactics: Command and Control
Platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS
Description: HTTP and HTTPS can carry many kinds of traffic. Use this reference to investigate a connection in context. A connection to port 443 alone is insufficient evidence of an incident.
